content.text: {"narrative":[{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $9.326 billion in 2022, followed by $8.920 billion in 2023 and $8.263 billion in 2024.","cites":["kpi:51","kpi:52","kpi:45"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $7.219 billion in 2020 and $8.122 billion in 2021.","cites":["kpi:49","kpi:50"]},{"claim":"In 2024 UNICEF's Core Resources income was $1.584 billion, which was 46% of total income.","cites":["kpi:40","kpi:46"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's 2024 Core Resources income included $724.9 million from the private sector, $512.6 million from the public sector and $346.1 million from other partners.","cites":["kpi:42","kpi:41","kpi:43"]},{"claim":"Other Resources Regular accounted for 49% of UNICEF's total income in 2024, and Other Resources Emergency accounted for 5%.","cites":["kpi:47","kpi:48"]},{"claim":"In India in 2024, safely managed water supplies were provided to 59.3 million people and sanitation services to 17.9 million people.","cites":["kpi:61","kpi:62"]}]}
